title: Meta ARE scenario matrix
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for generating 1,000 dynamic environments, 1,000 decomposition methods, 1,000 operator personas and 1,000 multi-position stakeholders, evaluating stratified Latin-hypercube or 10^12 addressable tuples, and digesting safe trajectories into candidate Tasks and Task Objects.
boundaries: Made-up scenario episodes and digested candidates remain quarantined proposals until an authorized owner reviews and admits them.
High-PII offline airgap situations block unsplit cloud compute tiers deterministically; mixed private-and-public situations require explicit lane partitioning.
Every digested Task and Task Object preserves an explicit human_only boundary for safety, care, legal judgment and final release.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for 1,000x1,000x1,000x1,000 dynamic scenario generation, stakeholder boundary gating and Task/Task-Object digestion

value.lets_workers: Generate 1,000 Gaia2-style dynamic situations across 25 public-good and technical domains, pair them with 1,000 decomposition and compute strategies, 1,000 operator harness personas and 1,000 multi-position stakeholders, evaluate 1,000-cell Latin-hypercube sweeps or O(1) lookups across 10^12 tuples, and digest approved trajectories into SHA-256-pinned candidate Tasks and Task Objects.

flow.when: Materialize or extend the 1,000 environments, 1,000 methods, 1,000 personas and 1,000 stakeholders.
Run a 1,000-cell 4D Latin-hypercube sweep or bounded slice and apply stakeholder block and lane-partition gates.
Rank and hash approved trajectories into candidate Tasks (verbs) and Task Objects (nouns) with explicit human_only boundaries.

value.worked_example: Made-up 3-tuple episode bundle recomputed in test_scenario_matrix.py: blocks unsplit cloud inference on ENV-0001 offline shelter PII, partitions ENV-0002 mixed shelter intake into private local and public donor lanes, and approves ENV-0084 public municipal budget audit under verify-cascade.

nouns.title: Guardrail: block cloud compute tiers on offline airgap or unsplit high-PII situations
nouns.category_reason: Prevents raw sensitive intake, clinical or legal records from crossing into external model endpoints.

value.rule: Any episode with offline_airgap connectivity or high_pii_local_only sensitivity without explicit lane splitting and PII redaction is deterministically blocked before digestion.
value.how_it_is_checked: evaluate_and_digest_episode checks connectivity, sensitivity and privacy_boundary first and emits verdict blocked.

nouns.title: Guardrail: every digested candidate carries an explicit human_only boundary
nouns.category_reason: Keeps crisis follow-up, eligibility rulings, legal advice and release sign-off strictly with accountable people.

value.rule: Digested Task and Task-Object candidates always carry a non-empty domain-specific human_only boundary and surface_only visibility.
value.how_it_is_checked: evaluate_and_digest_episode stamps human_only and visibility_scope surface_only on every digested noun and verb.

nouns.title: Guardrail: never present made-up 1,000-episode sweeps as live field outcomes or admitted packs
nouns.category_reason: Maintains honest evidence separation between local deterministic matrix sweeps and real partner operations.

value.rule: Scenario matrix digests record mode local_verified or worker_llm_extended explicitly and keep digested candidates quarantined until owner admission.
value.how_it_is_checked: run_latin_hypercube_sweep_1000 stamps mode and status:quarantined on emitted digests.

nouns.title: Specification: 1,000x1,000x1,000x1,000 scenario matrix axes and 4D Latin-hypercube sweep
nouns.category_reason: Defines deterministic axis cardinalities, bijective 10^12 tuple indexing and stratified sweep invariants.

environments.factorization: 25 domains x 10 Gaia2 operational constraints x 4 sensitivity/connectivity regimes

methods.factorization: 5 topologies x 5 privacy boundaries x 40 valid (compute_tier, verification_gate) pairs

personas.factorization: 5 skill levels x 5 agent harnesses x 5 communication styles x 8 risk/accessibility profiles

stakeholders.factorization: 10 stakeholder positions x 10 institutional mandates x 5 strictness tiers x 2 authority scopes

nouns.title: Stakeholder evaluation and Task/Task-Object digestion rules
nouns.category_reason: Zero-call deterministic rules mapping (env, method, persona, stakeholder) tuples to verdicts and candidate pins.

nouns.title: Tool card: 1,000-scenario matrix generator, 10^12 tuple resolver and stakeholder digester
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python standard-library package pinned by path, file count and digest.

value.name: Meta ARE scenario matrix
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only, with optional worker llm_extender callback.
does: Generates 1,000 indexed environments, 1,000 methods, 1,000 operator personas and 1,000 stakeholders deterministically.
Evaluates 1,000-cell 4D Latin-hypercube sweeps covering every index 0001..1000 on all 4 axes and resolves arbitrary tuples in [0, 10^12 - 1] in O(1).
Applies stakeholder privacy, offline, latency and two-step review gates and digests approved episodes into SHA-256-hashed candidate Tasks and Task Objects.
does_not: Enqueue tasks automatically, widen visibility beyond surface_only or claim made-up sweeps are field deployments.

nouns.title: Template: stakeholder-gated scenario matrix evaluation and digested candidate summary

value.describes: deterministic verdicts, block reasons and digested Task and Task-Object slugs across evaluated 4-axis scenario tuples

nouns.title: Worked example input: three 4-axis scenario tuples spanning offline PII, mixed shelter intake and public budget audit
nouns.category_reason: Made-up scenario tuple bundle recomputed by test_scenario_matrix.py.

nouns.title: Worked example output: recomputed stakeholder verdicts, block reasons and digested Nouns and Verbs

verbs.title: Generate 1,000 environments, 1,000 methods, 1,000 personas and 1,000 stakeholders
verbs.summary: Deterministically generate all four 1,000-item scenario axes (ENV-0001..ENV-1000, METH-0001..METH-1000, PERS-0001..PERS-1000, STKH-0001..STKH-1000) with SHA-256 content digests.
verbs.outcome: Verified 4x1,000 scenario catalog covering 25 domains, 5 topologies, 6 compute tiers, 5 harnesses and 10 stakeholder roles.

slots.name: seed_config
slots.description: Pin of seed and optional slice configuration.

steps: Run generate_environments_1000, generate_methods_1000, generate_personas_1000 and generate_stakeholders_1000.
Verify all 4,000 SHA-256 digests are unique and every environment names an explicit human_only boundary.

acceptance.check: Each of the four axes produces 1,000 records with 1,000 distinct SHA-256 digests.

verbs.title: Evaluate a 1,000-cell 4D Latin-hypercube sweep under multi-position stakeholder gates
verbs.summary: Pair all 1,000 environments, methods, personas and stakeholders via a seeded 4D Latin-hypercube bijection and apply privacy, offline, two-step review and latency gates.
verbs.outcome: Deterministic episode verdicts separating approved_direct, approved_partitioned and blocked trajectories.

slots.name: episode_bundle
slots.description: Pin of tuple coordinates or Latin-hypercube seed specification.

steps: Run run_latin_hypercube_sweep_1000 or run_worked_example across the requested tuple set.
Verify every offline_airgap or unsplit high_pii_local_only cloud trajectory is blocked.

acceptance.check: evaluate_and_digest_episode blocks cloud tiers in offline_airgap and unsplit high_pii_local_only regimes.

verbs.title: Digest approved scenario trajectories into candidate Tasks and Task Objects
verbs.summary: Aggregate approved and lane-partitioned trajectories across 25 domains into SHA-256-pinned candidate Tasks (verbs) and Task Objects (nouns) with human_only boundaries.
verbs.outcome: Conforming matrix digest listing top reusable Task and Task-Object candidates ready for distinct human or worker review.
steps: Aggregate approved_direct and approved_partitioned episodes by Task and Task-Object slug.
Verify every digested candidate carries surface_only visibility, a SHA-256 content hash and an explicit human_only boundary.

acceptance.check: Output validates against template.matrix-digest and preserves human_only boundaries.
